newsitem.title: USA: Virginia sees 5.8 pct revenue growth in fiscal 1Q.
newsitem.headline: Virginia sees 5.8 pct revenue growth in fiscal 1Q.

text.p: Virginia revenues for first quarter fiscal 1997 increased 5.8 percent over the same period last year, Richmond Times-Dispatch reported Sunday.
The growth rate for the quarter that began July 1 was 2.1 percentage points above the projected annual growth rate of 3.7 percent.
State finance direcotr Ronald Tillett said the gain reflects strong income tax withholding and sales tax collections, which together account for 75 percent of state revenues.
However, Tillet cautioned that it was too early to count on a windfall because revenue growth is expected to slow later in the two-year budget cycle, which runs through June 30, 1998.
